description:
workflows/contractenrollment — POST /traeger/contract-enrollments/preview (#7760, ADR 0309 section 4), a school
with one linked and two unlinked imported contracts: the schools of the Träger; the Träger transaction
with the contracts, their timelines, the contracted application children and one trail entry; the
school's tenant transaction with the plan (offerings, phases, accepted applications), the check of the
school's enrollment (setting, phases, offerings, holders, child records and persons), the child records
shown and one access log entry. Flat in the number of contracts.
